request.prompt: Stylised hand-painted game VFX with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background. A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a blessing of healing light. Frames 1 to 4: a gentle green-gold glow rises from the bottom as petals of light spiral upward. Frames 5 to 10: a bloom of white-green light opens at the centre with sparkles drifting up. Frames 11 to 16: the light softens and fades until the last frame is nearly black. Soft green, gold and white.
